name: Analog clock
author: WinDock
description: An analog clock drawn from a face file (faces/*.json: dial, ticks, numerals, hands, date window). Optional second hand (ticking or smooth), the date on the face and the time under the dial.

settings.label: Face
settings.description: Every faces/*.json of the widget. Export the widget (Settings > Widgets) and add your own face files to its faces folder.

settings.label: Second hand motion

choices.label: Smooth (30 frames a second while the dock is on screen)

settings.description: Smooth costs about 30 wake-ups and redraws a second while the dock is shown; none while it is hidden. With reduce motion it ticks.

choices.label: Weekday and day (at 12), month and year (at 6)

settings.label: Sweep the hands in when the clock appears or its face changes
settings.description: A short animation (about 0.7 s); never with reduce motion.

settings.label: Size in DIPs (0: the dock's icon size)
